# Bloomberg Law reports that Burford is expected to join Russell 3000® and 2000® indexes


May 29, 2024


-
-
-
-


Bloomberg Law's "Wakeup Call" includes news that Burford Capital is expected to join the broad-market Russell 3000 and small-cap Russell 2000 Indexes after the US market opens on July 1, 2024, marking "'the first entry of legal finance—an emerging asset class—to the Indexes.'"


[Click here to view full article.](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/ip-law/wake-up-call-latham-on-london-hiring-spree-aims-to-dominate)
